metadata.title: Using Dupli-Color Metal Specks for a Retro Car Paint Look
metadata.description:
Dupli-Color® has taken old school color, introduced it to new school, and created Metal Specks™: a retro car paint look in a can. Learn how our new technology in paints and coatings combined with hot retro colors creates a metallic auto paint look that jumps out at you. In the sunlight, Dupli-Color Metal Specks shimmers with tiny floating metallic pieces suspended in color. Available in Retro Red and Ocean Blue. Perfect for any automotive accessory, bikes, and helmets. Go back in time today!

LEARN MORE HERE:
http://duplicolor.com/product/metal-specks-automotive-paint

He then wipes the helmet with a prep‑wipe and follows with a clean white cloth and a tack cloth to remove any residue. After the surface is dry, he sprays an adhesion promoter and lets it flash off before wiping again. He selects a fan‑spray can of Dupli‑Color Metal Specks (orange‑burnt‑copper) and applies a light, even coat, rotating the helmet to cover all surfaces, repeating for a total of three coats and ensuring even coverage around the whole helmet. The finished helmet displays a bright, shimmering metallic finish, and the segment ends with a title screen.
